title: Study Comparing Etanercept With Usual DMARD Therapy in Subjects With Rheumatoid Arthritis in the Asia Pacific Region
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the efficacy of etanercept with usual disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drug (DMARD) therapy in the treatment of moderate to severe rheumatoid arthritis (RA) over 16 weeks in the Asia Pacific region.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of RA
* Currently receiving an adequate dose of methotrexate (MTX) for treatment of RA
* Active RA at time of screening and baseline

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous or current treatment with etanercept (ETN), other tumor necrosis factor-alpha inhibitors, or other biologic agents
* Concurrent treatment with a DMARD, other than MTX, at screening
* Receipt of any DMARD, other than MTX, within 3 months before screening
